mapping: Each complete painting maps once across the world raster, then clips to its layer. No atlas crops, resizing, seed shifts or repeats.

prompts.sand: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: full-screen desert terrain material for a painted 2D artillery game. Generate ONE landscape 4:3 image, requested resolution 2048x1536 or higher. The ENTIRE canvas from edge to edge must be covered by ONE continuous material, with fine crisp hand-painted detail at native resolution. Orthographic material view, even warm lighting from upper left, consistent detail scale everywhere, no perspective or distant fading. Rich natural ochre/terracotta palette, refined illustrated game art. No sky, horizon, terrain silhouette, objects, vegetation, text, frames, panels, atlas strips or separate materials. This will be clipped into irregular terrain layers at runtime. Golden desert sand, softly wind-rippled with fine grains, scattered tiny ochre pebbles and delicate shallow irregular horizontal ripples. Warm pale golden amber, restrained contrast; sand everywhere in the frame.
